 Oral Order

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner seeks bail in anticipation of her arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504 and 34 of the IPC.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner being mother-in-law has been falsely implicated in the instant case.

4. It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated with general, omnibus and ornamental allegation in a mechanical manner.

It is further submitted that from perusal of the allegation as alleged in the FIR,
it would Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.26543 of 2024(2) dt.16-04-2024 also manifest that the allegation against the petitioner is general and omnibus in nature.
5. The learned APP opposes the anticipatory bail application.
